description: Stuck on the bus: Toronto's 2024 budget offers no relief for Scarborough’s weary commuters Jan 13, 2024 Residents and transit advocates see the lack of busway funding as the latest example of how the area has been neglected by politicians at city hall and Queen’s Park. Successive administrations have spent decades playing political ping-pong with the replacement for the aging RT — at one point it was going to be an LRT — ultimately leaving Scarborough residents today without rapid transit for years. “Sometimes it feels like the city views Scarborough residents’ time as less valuable," said Krissan Veerasingam, board member for transit advocacy group TTCriders.

description: Asado June 26 – 28 + June 26 – 28 Asado Canada’s ultimate Asado experience is firing up again at Assembly Park! Hosted by Copa Cabana & Toronto Latinos , prepare for two days of smoky grills, vibrant Latin rhythms, and nonstop summer energy! June 27 to 28, 2026 FRI: 6PM – 11PM | SAT: 12 PM – 11 PM | SUN: 12 PM – 8PM FREE ENTRY before 6 PM | 10 years and under FREE | Registration Required What To Expect: A vibrant cultural marketplace with 50+ Latin vendors & culinary teams Non-stop Latin music, DJs & live performances Authentic Asado cuisine and Latin street food from across the region Copa Cabana—one of Canada’s top steakhouses—is back taking the lead on food! Outdoor bar, interactive spaces & community experiences Dancing, culture, and community vibe all weekend long Visit www.torontolatinos.com for your complimentary tickets and more information.

description: HopFest April 3 – 5 + April 3 – 5 HopFest Hop into the springtime fun at HopFest , Vaughan’s egg-citing celebration! Bring the whole family for a day filled with sweet treats, festive activities, and playful surprises around every corner. April 3 – 5, 2026 10 AM – 6 PM Admission & Activity Tickets Available for Purchase What to Expect: Egg Hunts – Join the fun and find hidden treasures throughout the garden Garden Crafts – Create colourful keepsakes to take home (Saturday only, while quantities last) Sweet Treats & Eats – Enjoy delicious snacks and seasonal goodies Carnival Rides & Games – Laugh, play, and make magical memories Bunny Photo Ops – Capture your hoppiest moments with the Easter Bunny Vendor Market — Presented by Toronto Made Market Costumes and bunny ears encouraged — smiles guaranteed! Get your tickets here! Visit www.hopfest.ca for more information.

title: Screemers
location: Toronto’s most shocking haunted home. Plus, enjoy live shows , midway rides , and food
description: Screemers October 10 – November 1 + October 10 – November 1 Screemers Screemers is back for the ultimate haunted experience this Halloween! Enter, if you dare, for one the GTA’s most terrifying and immersive Halloween attractions. October 10 to November 1, 2025 (select days) 7 PM – 12 AM (midnight) (select days) General & VIP Tickets Available For Purchase Step into 7 Haunts of Horror, each packed with live actors, chilling effects, and nightmares brought to life: Medieval Massacre – Face vengeful knights and plague-ridden spirits.
